summary: Renders a quad by emitting four vertices (triangle strip) through sub_553650, skipping the render entirely when the a2 parameter is 0.0. The base Y position depends on the participant slot field this+0x8: -1 selects 0.0 (top row), any other value selects 140.0. The quad geometry is scaled from this+0xE4 (width factor) and this+0xE8 (height factor) against 1280.0 and 50.0. Invoked by sub_4D8A30 as a HUD quad render helper.

local_names.v2: base Y offset for the quad (0.0 when this+0x8 == -1, else 140.0)

operations.description: Skip the entire quad render when a2 == 0.0; the function then returns an uninitialized value.
Slot guard: when this+0x8 == -1 (0xFFFFFFFF) the base Y is 0.0 (top row); otherwise it is 140.0.
Compute quad geometry from the screen-size fields: v6 = this+0xE4 * 0.0; v9 = ybase * this+0xE8; v8 = this+0xE4 * 1280.0; v7 = this+0xE8 * 50.0.
sub_553650(0, v6, v9, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0x80000000) emits vertex 0 of the quad.
v10 = v7 + v9 (right-edge Y of the second row).
sub_553650(1, v6, v10, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0x80000000) emits vertex 1 of the quad.
sub_553650(2, v11, v4, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0x80000000) emits vertex 2 of the quad.
sub_553650(3, v11, v3, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0x80000000) emits vertex 3 and its result is returned as the function result.
Invoked by sub_4D8A30 (0x004D8A30) as a HUD quad render helper; the ABI description records quad triangle-strip rendering with colors.
